dialog.title: Pair reader
dialog.insecureWarning: This page does not use a secure connection. Someone on your network could show you a fake code, and a code you type here could be read by others. Check the code on the reader itself and pair only on a network you trust.

mode.takeover: A reader that takes over one I already have (after a reset or as a replacement)

dialog.connectionLost: Connection to the server lost. The status shown here may be out of date.
dialog.failed: Pairing failed. The reader starts over with a new code by itself.
dialog.expired: Pairing timed out. The reader starts over with a new code.

reason.cancelled-at-reader: It was cancelled at the reader.
reason.cancelled-by-admin: It was cancelled in the admin interface.
reason.reader-disconnected: The reader disconnected before pairing finished.
reason.protocol: Something went wrong on the reader. Try again.
reason.internal: An error occurred on the server.
reason.expired: The reader was not approved within 10 minutes.

dialog.findHint: Enter the code shown on the reader.
dialog.typeCode: Enter the code the reader shows right now.
dialog.scanTitle: Scan the QR code on the reader
dialog.liteHint: For a Lite reader, choose it here and compare its colours:
dialog.comparePattern: Compare these colours with the ring on the reader, from segment 1 on.
dialog.patternHint: Segment 1 is marked on the reader. Approve only if all eight colours match. The colours change about every 30 seconds.
dialog.patternChanged: The colours changed while you were checking. Compare them again and then approve.
dialog.noResponse: The reader did not respond. Check that it is switched on and has the latest software, then try again.

error.wrongCode: This code does not match the reader. Check the code on the reader and try again.
error.codeNotFound: No waiting reader shows this code. Check the code on the reader; it changes about every 30 seconds.
error.ambiguous: Two readers show this code right now. Wait for the next code on the reader and try again.
error.stale: The colours changed. Compare the new colours and approve again.
error.notWaiting: This reader is no longer waiting to be paired. It may have been paired already or started over.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.rateLimitedRetry: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
error.unknown: The reader could not be paired
error.failed: Pairing failed because of an error on the server. The reader starts over with a new code by itself.
error.readerGone: The reader disconnected before pairing finished. It will show a new code.
error.keyInUse: This reader is already paired with another record. Choose that record to take over, or remove its pairing first.
error.targetNotFound: The reader to take over no longer exists. Choose another one.
error.targetMissing: Choose which reader this one takes over.
error.wrongMode: This reader cannot be paired this way. Close this window and start again from the reader list.

security.title: Pairing
security.immediateHint: These actions take effect right away. You do not need to save.
security.repairDescription: Use this after the reader was reset, or when you swap in a different reader, for example after a defect. You enter the code of the reader or compare its colours. Name, machines and settings stay. The old pairing stops working right away.
security.revokeDescription: Disconnects this reader right away. It cannot be used until you pair it again.
security.revokeMessage: The reader disconnects within a second and can no longer be used. It starts over as a new reader and shows up in the reader list under Not paired, where you can pair it again.

toPair.title: Not paired
toPair.description: A new reader shows a code on its screen (Lite: colours on its ring). Press Pair, then type the code or compare the colours. Pair these readers before you can set them up; readers that sign in with a token keep working until then. The reader must be switched on and connected.
toPair.notConnected: The reader is not connected right now. Switch it on and try again.

enrollLink.noPermission: Your account does not have permission to approve readers. Ask an administrator to approve this reader.
